name: Chip supply
summary: China's rare-earth export pause expires 10 Nov; TSMC capacity tight but no output stoppage
state: China's suspension of its expanded rare-earth export controls expires on 10 Nov with no formal extension published as of 7 Nov (Mining Technology). Leading-edge capacity at TSMC remains tight, with chip prices rising on AI demand (TMGM). No TSMC or Samsung output stoppage had been reported as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Tight chip supply tends to lengthen lead times and raise prices for electronics.
rubric_hit: Export controls pending and tight supply = Watch; no major TSMC/Samsung disruption (Alert)

sources.title: Mining Technology — China rare earth export pause nears expiry
TMGM — TSMC's 2nm process may be impacted by supply chain uncertainty

why: Advanced chips underpin everything from phones to AI to weapons; supply is concentrated in Taiwan and Korea.
drivers: Export controls, Taiwan risk, fab outages, AI demand, materials.

rubric.alert: Major disruption to TSMC/Samsung output, or controls halting a major supply chain.
rubric.watch: New export controls, shortages reported in key segments, or a fab outage.
rubric.normal: Supply normal; no new major controls.
